summary: stui falls back through the daemon after any failed direct terminal attachment by default, keeps the failure reason visible, and offers a per-device fabric only setting

replay.detail: No replay, backfill, stored data or transcript change.

schema.detail: No wire or published schema changes. The optional terminal_fallback preference is local to this device.

rules.detail: No authority change. The daemon path rechecks the same terminal subject and incarnation after direct failure, including owner refusal.

compatibility.detail: An absent terminal_fallback preference enables daemon fallback. The palette offers fabric only, no fallback. Failed local PTY opens, missing Fabric, peers or grants, dial or tunnel failures, timeouts and owner refusal keep their cause in the terminal route. Only owner-level Fabric failures are remembered for 60 seconds. A restarted terminal is rejected; attach errors never rediscover a replacement process.

downtime.detail: Ordinary rolling deployment; no data conversion or extra startup work.

manual.detail: No host configuration is required. The terminal routing choice is stored in this device’s stui prefs and applies on the next attachment or reattachment.

recovery.detail: No recovery, durable payload or initialization changes.
